title: "Together Learning Haskell/Plutus in native language" Club

ms.promise:
- Establish "Together Learning Haskell/Plutus in native language" Club and Accept member registrations.
- Conduct the first workshop - Kick off meeting: 
 + Introduction to the club and its activities
 + Overview of Cardano, Catalyst and the Haskell Course 
 + Dividing members into groups; Assigning lessons to each group.
- Learning Haskell together - Lessons 1-4 with these sessions (One session per week and longer lessons may be split into two sessions):
 + Lesson 1. Intro to Haskell
 + Lesson 2. Data types, Signatures, and Polymorphism
 + Lesson 3. Conditions and helper constructions
 + Lesson 4. Pattern matching and Case
 + Review Lessons 1-4 and Take the Monthly Test

ms.report:
1. Member registration and first workshop result:
 a. On March 20, 2024, we held the club's first workshop, two weeks after the opening of the registration form, with the following key content:
 + An introduction to the journey of becoming a developer on the Cardano platform.
 + An overview of the content of the Haskell course.
 + An explanation of the club's operation and organizational structure, as well as the incentive rewards for members.
 + Group assignments and task distribution. An initial count of 20 registered members who are ready to participate, divided into 4 groups.
 Members' information is collected in the "Members" sheet in file Summary of Club Activities.
 The registration results from the Google form are available here.
 b. Telegram group for members, including a main group and 4 individual groups for each member group.
2. Learning sessions are scheduled every Wednesday at 20:30 Vietnam time. All the videos/documents are shared publicly for everyone.
 a. 5 recorded videos of the learning sessions
 Lesson 1
 Lesson 2
 Lesson 3
 Lesson 4
 Lesson 1-4 Review session
 b. 4 lecture slides are shared at Lecture Slides folder. 
 c. The Github repository The GitHub repository contains weekly, monthly assignments, and members' submissions
 To prevent members from viewing each other's submissions, we use Google forms for submissions. After the submission deadline, submissions are uploaded to GitHub for review by the assigned group and for members to view. Therefore, we don't need to collect members' GitHub accounts.
 d. Test results (4 Weekly and 1 monthly assignments) of members are updated in the "Assignment Test Results" sheet in file Summary of Club Activities.
3. Additional references:
 + Club activities are summarized in the file Summary of Club Activities.
 + Weekly updates on club activities are posted on the Cardano forum.
